test_supervisor_start_and_snapshot: test starting a browser supervisor and verifying it exposes an active snapshot with a top frame
test_main_frame_alert_detection_and_dism: test detecting and dismissing an alert dialog fired in the main browser frame
test_iframe_contentwindow_alert: test detecting an alert dialog fired from inside a same-origin iframe
test_prompt_dialog_with_response_text: test responding to a prompt dialog with custom prompt_text that round-trips into the page
test_browser_cdp_frame_id_routes_via_sup: test routing browser_cdp Runtime.evaluate calls through the supervisor using a frame_id
test_browser_dialog_tool_end_to_end: test calling the browser_dialog tool handler to dismiss an alert dialog end-to-end
test_recent_dialogs_ring_buffer: test that auto-dismissed dialogs appear in recent_dialogs with closed_by and closed_at metadata
test_bridge_captures_prompt_and_returns_: test that prompt dialog replies are properly bridged back into the page via Fetch.fulfillRequest
